valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E computed from the inputs on file (0.00) is not a valuation for a real business. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/B computed from the inputs on file (0) is not a valuation for a real business. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the P/E computed from the inputs on file (0.00) is not a valuation for a real business. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: _calc_coverage.json flags this value as computed from a wrong input (a share count or a profit filed in different units), and the engine still reproduces it. A blank is honest; a ratio built on a wrong input is not a valuation.

derived.marketCapBasis: shares outstanding x market price (JSE cents converted to rand, /100)
derived.marketCapSource: TradingView scanner (total_shares_outstanding); price 67.0 ZAc quoted in cents (= 0.67 ZAR per share)
derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 69.9999988079071) to the price on 2026-07-30
